texture_overrides_note: Linear's marketing canvas is the deepest dark in the brand library: #010102, near-pure black with a faint blue tint. Ink is the brand's light gray #f7f8f8 (17.7:1 on canvas) and the muted ladder uses ink-subtle #8a8f98 (6.1:1). The signature lavender accent is #5e6ad2, but on near-black it measures 4.4:1, a hair under the 4.5 floor, so the motion accent uses Linear's documented brighter lavender-hover #828fff (7.3:1) which keeps the exact hue family while clearing the WOW contrast gate and giving halation something to bloom. Per Linear's brand rule the lavender stays scarce: one accent diagram node, one accent edge, and the close accent line only, never as a fill or second color. Inter at 600 with -0.022 tracking substitutes for the proprietary Linear Display cut (the brand's own documented free fallback). grain 0.05 plus vignette 0.20 hold the quiet command-center atmosphere, halation 0.06 blooms the lavender on emphasis, lighting_arc 0.26 gives the SCHEMATIC its color drift.
